item.tib: gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi bshags
item.coloph: ces pa'i gsang sngags dam tshig spyi bshags 'di bzhin bri ('bri) dgos rtogs ldan bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bka' yi gnang don du/ ma rgyud bskang (skong) bshags/ 'gu ya srog 'dzin khro bo'i rgyud/ ge khod dbang rgyud me ri khyil ba/ dbal phur ka ba nag po/ gab gsang 'khor lo sogs kyi nang nas rtsa lag gi dam tshig bsdu ste (bsdus te) phyogs gcig tu dbal khyung gter ming pa gsang sngags gling pas bris pa'o//
